units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 27:12">Kel. XXVII, 12</cite> <he>אף מ׳ חדשה וכ׳</he> even a new piece of that stuff.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:11">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> top <he>וטולין במ׳</he> and is mended by underlining a patch.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:2">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>, beg. <he>יעשה מ׳ לרקיע</he> let there be made a lining to the firmament (be made stronger).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:2">Kel. XXVI, 2</cite> <he>טלה עליו את המְטֶלֶת</he> (R. S. <cite ref="M01010"><he>מטלית</he></cite>) if he underlined the bag.
Tosef. Ohol. XIV, 6; Zeb. 94ᵃ; a. fr.—Trnsf. a strip of land.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:3">Lam. R. to III, 7</cite> (ref. to <he>גדר בעדי</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:3">ib.</cite>) <he>זו מ׳ של וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M01008"><he>מטליה</he></cite>) that means the Samaritan enclave (between Galilee and Judaea).—Pl. <he>מַטְלִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:3">Ib.</cite> introd., end <he>זורעין אותה מ׳ מ׳</he> they planted the land by strips (not the whole at a time); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:12">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> top <he>מ׳ מ׳ היתה נשרפת</he> the land was burned up strip-wise; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:12">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite>; Pesik. Dibré, p. 114ᵃ; (Yalk. Dan. 1066 <he>מטלניות</he>). Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 3, ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 24:6">Ez. XXIV, 6</cite>) <he>מ׳ מ׳ היו גולים</he> they were exiled by districts (not all at once); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 362:6">Yalk. Ez. 362</cite>.—Dimin. <cite ref="M01021"><he>מַטְלוֹנִית</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01015"><he>מַטְלָנִית</he></cite>; pl. <he>מַטְלוֹנִיּוֹת</he>, <he>מַטְלָ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 125a:3">Sabb. 125ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ שאין בהן וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>מטליות</he>) strips of less than three square handbreadths; <cite ref="Sukkah 16a:3">Succ. 16ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 20a">B. Bath. 20ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—Yalk. Dan. 1066, v. supra.
